raw.details:
TRIVORA – National-Level 24-Hour Hackathon

Where Ideas Get Real & Bold Minds Get Rewarded!

HackHere presents TRIVORA, a national-level 24-hour hackathon where creativity meets technology! Explore the power of Generative AI × Cloud Computing, tackle real-world challenges, and transform bold ideas into intelligent, scalable solutions.

Think Beyond Prompts. Build Beyond Limits. Scale Beyond Expectations.

Event Details

  • Date: 5th & 6th December 2026

  • ⏳ Duration: 24 Hours

  • Prize Pool: ₹50,000

  • Theme: Generative AI × Cloud

  • Mode: Offline

  • Team Size: 1–4 Members

  • Registration Fee: ₹1,000 per team

  • ️ Registration: Limited Slots

Why Participate?

  • ₹50,000 Prize Pool & Exciting Rewards

  • Internship & Career Opportunities

  • ️ Exclusive AI & Cloud Credits

  • Goodies, Swags & Partner Benefits

  • Industry Mentorship & Networking

  • Certificates & Recognition

  • Hands-on AI & Cloud Product Development

The Challenge

The Cloud Is Your Playground. AI Is Your Superpower!

Teams will receive an allocated real-world problem statement under the theme of Generative AI × Cloud Computing.

Your mission? Ideate, Code, Build & Deploy a functional solution within 24 hours!
Assigned challenges cannot be changed or exchanged.

Hackathon Workflow

Phase 1 – Challenge Reveal & Ideation
Receive your assigned problem statement, brainstorm solutions, and plan your approach.

Phase 2 – Build & Deploy
Develop an AI-powered prototype using cloud technologies, with guidance from industry mentors.

Phase 3 – Final Showdown
Submit your solution and demonstrate your work before the jury for evaluation.

Eligibility & Rules

  • Open to all UG & PG students across disciplines.

  • Teams may have 1–4 members.

  • Inter-college and inter-department teams are allowed.

  • Each participant can belong to only one team.

  • Solutions must be developed during the official hackathon period.

  • Plagiarism and unfair practices are prohibited.

Submission Requirements

Teams must submit:

  • Working Prototype / MVP

  • Presentation Deck

  • Source-Code Repository

  • Technology Stack & Solution Description

  • Cloud Deployment Details

  • Demo Link (where applicable)

Evaluation Criteria

Solutions will be judged on Innovation, Generative AI Integration, Cloud Implementation, Technical Quality, Functionality, Scalability, Real-World Impact, and Final Presentation.

Ready to Build Beyond Limits?

24 Hours. Real Challenges. ₹50,000 on the Line!
Turn your ideas into working products, connect with industry experts, and compete with talented innovators from across the country.

Bring Your Squad. Build the Future. Own the Spotlight!
Limited Slots Available — Register Now!

Organised by HackHere
